description: Locate the Person record for 'Marcus PII-Holder' in ArkCase. A privacy request document with details is located at '~/Documents/privacy_request.txt'. You must: 1) Search for and open the person record. 2) Edit the record to anonymize it: Change First Name to 'Redacted', Change Last Name to 'User-[ID]' (where [ID] is the system Person ID, e.g., 'User-2025001') OR 'User-Anonymized'. 3) Clear/delete the values in the 'Email' and 'Business Phone' fields. 4) Save the changes.
